RAW-SCORE+AUX-GEO.role: treatment: the same trunk and score head, plus training-only heads predicting the auxiliary targets

capacity.accounting: total = persistent inference parameters + training-only auxiliary parameters; both reported, neither hidden

contract.exam: E0004 CVS-DEEP 400k over the 200 held-out identities
contract.student: RAW-768 -> H clipped-ReLU -> score; MAX_UPDATES 760 x BATCH 256 = 194560 presentations for every cell; cold start; T0004-derived optimizer/LR/init/K/LAMBDA
contract.teacher: CVS-4k over D0036 (S13/S14 unchanged; TargetSpec sha256:6b8bd7dcc1ac… asserted against X0008's sealed 4k arm)

fairness: identical RAW-768 inputs in both arms
identical score labels, positions and split identities
identical persistent score topology and optimizer
no inference-time inputs added to the treatment arm
training-only parameters and extra training FLOPs reported

family_ablation.lattice: a SECOND experiment, frozen only if the trigger fires
family_ablation.not_run_is_a_result: if the trigger does not fire, no ablation runs and the absence is recorded as the rule's outcome
family_ablation.reading: per family group, (full - removed) change in score loss at the sentinel width; negative findings preserved
family_ablation.trigger: run iff the H=1 primary contrast's one-sided UPPER bound is below zero (auxiliary strictly better at the smallest width). The rule is frozen here, before outcomes

loss.auxiliary: mean(value MSE over families) + mean(4-class cross-entropy over families), each averaged so no family dominates by column count
loss.schedule: fixed for the whole run; no per-seed or per-width tuning

weight_provenance.rule: 25% of the score loss's trunk gradient at initialisation, measured on TRAINING rows only

primary_analysis.caveat: better auxiliary prediction is not evidence of better chess judgment unless the score exam also improves
primary_analysis.contrast: per width, paired by seed: RAW-SCORE+AUX-GEO - RAW-SCORE on E0004 test_loss, separate one-sided 95% exact-t bounds at that width's df
metrics: inference throughput after auxiliary heads are disabled
auxiliary prediction quality by named family
primary_analysis.no_pooling: widths reported separately; no global winner

questions: does explicit semantic supervision help a RAW evaluator learn a better static representation even when no semantic features are supplied at inference?
if it helps, does it reduce the learned capacity needed for a given quality?
which named geometry families provide useful training signal?
status: materialized before the lattice is frozen and before any outcome is inspected
stop_conditions: the D0036 TargetSpec hash differs from X0008's sealed 4k arm
the auxiliary targets do not align with the encoded training rows
the geometry registry hash differs from the manifest's pin
